title: Electronics Production -Assistant Manager
description:
Electronics Production Assistant Manager Defence Electronics Position Overview We are looking for an experienced Electronics Production Assistant Manager with strong expertise in Class 3 electronics assemblies and experience in the defence/aerospace or high-reliability electronics sector . The role will be responsible for overseeing the end-to-end manufacturing, assembly, integration, testing, and delivery of mission-critical electronic products while ensuring the highest standards of quality, reliability, compliance, productivity, and on-time delivery. The position requires strong knowledge of IPC standards, defence manufacturing requirements, electronics production processes, troubleshooting, testing, and cross-functional coordination with Engineering, Design, Quality, Product Management, and Supply Chain teams. Job Details Position: Electronics Production Assistant Manager Industry: Defence Electronics / Aerospace / Experience: 7–12 Years Location: Talegaon Dabhade, Pune Joining: Immediate Joiners / Candidates with Short Notice Period preferred Qualification: Engineering/Technical qualification in Electronics, Electrical Key Responsibilities Lead and oversee the end-to-end production and testing of defence-grade electronic systems, units, cards, and assemblies . Ensure manufacturing activities comply with Class 3 electronics quality and reliability requirements and applicable defence/industry standards. Coordinate with Design, Engineering, Quality, Product Management, Supply Chain, and other cross-functional teams to meet product performance, quality, and delivery requirements. Manage production planning, scheduling, manpower/resource allocation, capacity planning, and cost control . Troubleshoot production issues and drive Root Cause Analysis (RCA), Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPA) . Lead, mentor, and develop the production team, promoting a culture of quality, accountability, safety, and continuous improvement . Drive process improvement initiatives to improve yield, reduce rejection/waste, increase throughput, and improve productivity . Evaluate and implement automation, digitalization, manufacturing tools, and Industry 4.0 solutions . Support and manage internal and external quality/manufacturing audits . Support CapEx planning, budgeting, resource allocation, cost estimation, and cost control . Monitor key production KPIs including yield, productivity, quality, delivery, capacity utilization, and cost . Ensure effective implementation of ESD, safety, quality, and process-control requirements across the manufacturing environment. Required Technical Skills Strong working knowledge of IPC-A-610 and IPC/WHMA-A-620 . Hands-on experience in PCB assembly, electronic unit assembly, integration, inspection, and testing . Good understanding of analog and digital electronics, circuits, schematics, drawings, and electronic cards/units . Knowledge of wire harness assembly and testing . Understanding of Environmental Stress Screening (ESS) and applicable ESS specifications/processes. Knowledge of relevant MIL standards and defence manufacturing requirements . Strong troubleshooting and debugging skills for electronic units, cards, PCB assemblies, and production failures . Good understanding of IPC, ISO, ESD, and quality-control requirements . Experience with ERP/PLM systems , preferably SAP. Working knowledge of Power BI or similar data-analytics tools . Knowledge of production documentation, process controls, inspection procedures, test procedures, and manufacturing records . Leadership & Soft Skills Strong team leadership, people management, and mentoring capabilities. Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills. Excellent cross-functional communication and coordination . Ability to work under tight timelines and high-reliability requirements . Strong focus on quality, compliance, productivity, and continuous improvement . Analytical and data-driven approach to production management. Ability to manage multiple priorities in a mission-critical manufacturing environment . Preferred Experience 7–12 years of relevant experience in electronics manufacturing/production. Experience in defence electronics, aerospace electronics, or high-reliability electronics will be highly preferred. Experience in Class 3 electronics production and testing . Experience managing production teams and driving yield improvement, productivity improvement, RCA/CAPA, and process optimization . Exposure to manufacturing audits, CapEx, budgeting, and cost control . Candidates with strong hands-on experience in electronics production, assembly, testing, troubleshooting, and integration are preferred. Immediate joiners or candidates available to join at short notice are strongly preferred. Location Talegaon Dabhade, Pune, Maharashtra How to Apply Interested candidates can share their updated CV with: Harshada Kalantri 
 Email: Harshada.Kalantri@larsentoubro.com Please mention “Electronics Production Assistant Manager – Talegaon” in the subject line while sharing your CV.

title: Sourcing Manager
description:
Role & responsibilities Sourcing Manager Position Summary The Sourcing Manager with 10-13 years of experience responsible for developing and implementing strategic sourcing initiatives to meet the company's procurement requirements while optimizing costs, ensuring quality, and maintaining a reliable supply chain. The role involves supplier management, contract negotiations, cost analysis, risk mitigation, and continuous improvement of sourcing processes. Key Responsibilities Strategic Sourcing & Procurement Develop and implement sourcing strategies to meet organizational procurement needs while optimizing costs and maintaining quality standards. Manage the company's supply portfolio and ensure transparency of spending. Generate and implement efficient sourcing and category management strategies. Optimize sourcing procedures to achieve maximum efficiency and effectiveness. Analyze procurement costs and identify opportunities to reduce expenditure. Perform cost analysis, scenario analysis, and benchmarking activities. Supplier Management Evaluate and develop new suppliers. Visit production facilities and do capability checks where needed. Build sourcing strategies for our key fastener categories, balancing cost, quality, and supply security. Lead price negotiations and frame agreements with key suppliers, securing good payment terms and MOQs. Track suppliers performance (on-time delivery, quality, cost, responsiveness). Reduce supply risk by developing multiple sourcing channels, and keep an eye on raw material prices and logistics risks that could affect supply. Sales Support Work with Sales on customer bids, provide fast, accurate sourcing quotes and alert any delivery or feasibility risks. Use your supplier relationships and market knowledge to help Sales put together competitive bids that protect our margin. Purchasing Operations Work with suppliers on pricing, lead times, MOQs, and delivery schedules. Keep an eye on stock levels and work with Sales and Warehouse to balance having enough inventory without overstocking. Handle quality and delivery problems as they come upbe the first-person to suppliers call when something goes wrong, and make sure issues get fixed properly. Sustainability & Compliance Promote sustainability initiatives and actively communicate the company's sustainable value proposition to suppliers. Train and guide suppliers on our sustainability requirements. Help suppliers understand Bufab requirements and support suppliers gradually meet our standards over time. Check supplier practices against our sustainability checklist during visits and audits. Track their progress and follow up on gaps. Health, Safety & Quality Maintain awareness of and comply with Occupational Health & Safety requirements in accordance with ISO 45001 standards. Actively participate in workplace health and safety programs, including training, audits, and documentation activities. 
 Preferred candidate profile Education & Qualifications Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Supply Chain Management, or a related field. Background in Trading Environment/Fastener or General Hardware Multi Variety components would be an added advantage 815 years of relevant sourcing, procurement, or supply chain experience, preferably in a multinational organization. Strong command of written and spoken English. Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications (Excel, Word, PowerPoint) and ERP systems. Skills & Competencies Strong negotiation and contract management skills. Proficiency in procurement tools, ERP systems, and data analysis. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail. Solid understanding of procurement and supply chain management principles. Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities in a fast-paced environment. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills. Strong organizational and decision-making capabilities. Ability to work independently and collaboratively across functions.

Are you passionate about providing a world\-class customer experience? Do you want to unleash your potential for a global FinTech that is passionate about moving money for better? Do you want to further your career in Financial Services? If so, join Convera as a Customer Support Associate. Motivated by our values: Customer Champions, Growth Minded, Truth Seekers, Fast Movers, High Achievers, Respectfully Candid We are the largest non\-bank B2B cross\-border payments company in the world. Formerly Western Union Business Solutions, we leverage decades of industry experience and technology\-led payments solutions to deliver smarter money movements to our customers – helping them capture more value with every transaction. Convera serves more than 30,000 customers ranging from small business owners to enterprise treasurers to educational institutions to financial institutions to law firms to NGOs.
   

  

**In your role as Customer Support Associate, you will be:**
* Handling online requests from both Internal and External Customers in relation to both pre and post\-payment queries, in accordance with agreed SLAs and quality standards
* Keying in transactions, sending customer communications and processing payments
* Running, analyzing and providing reporting to internal and external clients
* Working closely with our Front Office teams to provide our clients with unrivalled levels of customer service
* Running daily controls to ensure smooth running of our day\-to\-day processing and working with other internal departments should any concerns arise
* Adhering to compliance and regulatory requirements whilst delivering high level of customer service to our clients
* You must be able to work well independently and as part of a team, be it in an office or remote environment You will ideally have:
* Experience in a busy team in a client facing function, within a financial services environment
* A passion for excellence in customer service and customer management along with proven track record for embedding this passion in team culture
* Excellent communication and listening skills with ability to network and build internal and external relationships at all levels.
* Excellent time management and attention to detail
* Proactive \& not afraid to speak up should you see something you don’t think looks right
* Experience using MS Outlook, Excel, Word, PowerPoint and the internet.


**Join us, and let’s move money simply, securely, smartly**
 Convera is delivering solutions ranging from simple currency exchanges to sophisticated risk management solutions and platforms. Everything we do is designed to enhance the customer experiences and seamlessly power their global commerce needs. It’s an exciting time for our organization, as the largest non\-bank cross\-border payment company in the world serving over 30k customers in more than 200 countries. If you’re ready to unleash your potential to help drive change, apply now. We’re a company on the move, and we want our people to grow and develop. You’ll have plenty of opportunities to learn new skills and build a career, as well as a great salary and benefits package. We are passionate about our diversity. Our commitment is to provide an inclusive culture that celebrates the unique backgrounds and perspectives of our global teams, while reflecting the communities we serve. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, national origin, religion, political affiliation, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, gender identity, age, disability, marital status, or veteran status.

* Solution Delivery: Exposure to delivering high\-quality solutions that meet client expectations, leveraging expertise in SAP S/4HANA based PLM applications to drive business value.

* SAP S/4HANA Configuration: Experience with configuring SAP S/4HANA PLM applications to support business processes and ensure seamless integration.

description:
JD for Agentic AI Lead Digital Engineering Opportunity in Modern Technology Platforms Step into the Digital Engineering Studio, where bold ideas, data, and intelligent automation come together to redefine the future of insurance. This is a high-energy environment for young technologists who are eager to learn, build, and innovate at scale. You ll work across project governance, UI/UX engineering, API development, and modern web and mobile platforms, creating intuitive portals for self-buying health insurance, policy renewal, and claims tracking. Every solution you build-whether customer-facing or agent-enabled-will have real-world impact, shaping seamless digital journeys for millions. For aspiring Data Engineers and AI enthusiasts, this role adds an exciting edge. You ll design and power data pipelines that fuel RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) solutions, enable intelligent search, and support AI-driven decisioning across Insurance Digital platforms. With access to AI-powered coding assistants and agentic development tools, you ll accelerate development while learning best-in-class engineering practices. From leading Core Policy Admin System integrations to connecting with government ecosystems like ONDC, PMBY, and SARTHI, you ll gain hands-on exposure to large-scale, mission-critical systems-perfect for those who want to grow fast, experiment fearlessly, and build the digital backbone of tomorrow s insurance landscape. We are seeking an Agentic AI Lead with strong hands-on and strategic expertise in architecting and delivering intelligent, autonomous, and AI-enabled applications at enterprise scale, leveraging modern agentic and GenAI frameworks, cloud-native platforms, and scalable backend architectures. The role requires deep experience leading the design and development of robust backend and platform services, integrating enterprise APIs and diverse data sources, working with relational databases such as PostgreSQL, and deploying production-grade systems on Google Cloud Platform (GCP) using mature CI/CD pipelines. The ideal candidate is a customer- and business-centric technology leader who can translate complex requirements into secure, resilient, and high-quality agentic solutions supporting web, mobile, and enterprise workflows, while setting architectural direction, enforcing engineering excellence, and guiding teams on advanced agent orchestration patterns, DevOps/MLOps best practices, and reliable delivery of impactful AI-driven digital solutions. Candidate should have experience of Leveraging AI-assisted development tools (e.g., code generation, code reviews, debugging assistants) to improve coding speed, quality, and developer productivity. Demonstrate openness to adopting AI-based tools and workflows to accelerate development while adhering to coding standards and best practices. Understanding of the general insurance domain is good to have. Location: Pune - Work from Office Notice Period: Up to 2 Months. Agentic AI Lead - 8+ Years Roles & Responsibilities Provide enterprise-wide technical and strategic leadership for the vision, architecture, and execution of large-scale agentic AI platforms and solutions across multiple business lines and domains. Own the agentic AI technology roadmap , guiding long-term evolution of agent architectures, platforms, accelerators, and operating models aligned with business and industry strategy. Lead the design and governance of complex, distributed agentic systems , including multi-agent ecosystems, cross-domain orchestration, long-running autonomous workflows, and human-in-the-loop decision systems. Set architectural guardrails and engineering standards for agent design, orchestration, memory, state management, reasoning, planning, and failure recovery at enterprise scale. Act as the highest level of technical authority on agent behaviour and intelligence, taking oversight and accountability for reasoning strategies, planning algorithms, escalation logic, risk handling, and system trustworthiness. Architect highly composable AI systems that integrate LLMs, traditional ML models, enterprise tools, APIs, event-driven systems, data platforms, and cloud-native services into cohesive intelligent workflows. Drive large-scale enterprise integration , enabling agentic platforms to work seamlessly with legacy systems, core business applications, data ecosystems, and partner platforms. Define and institutionalize enterprise reference architectures , design patterns, reusable IP, accelerators, and engineering playbooks for agentic AI adoption. Champion Responsible AI at an enterprise level , embedding governance, explainability, risk controls, auditability, privacy, security, and regulatory compliance across platforms and solutions. Partner with executive stakeholders, business leaders, and enterprise architects to shape AI-driven business transformation, translating strategic objectives into scalable agentic capabilities. Oversee system performance and economics , driving optimization across quality, accuracy, latency, throughput, reliability, and cost at portfolio scale. Provide executive oversight for production operations , including incident management, systemic risk mitigation, platform resilience, and SLA adherence across mission-critical deployments. Build and lead high-performing agentic engineering teams , mentoring senior technologists, principal engineers, and architects, and setting a culture of technical excellence and innovation. Drive innovation, thought leadership, and external visibility , contributing to internal IP, accelerators, whitepapers, patents, conferences, and client-facing AI transformation initiatives. Education BE / B.Tech in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline Postgraduate qualification (M.Tech / MS / MBA - preferred) Required Experience & Technical Skills 14-18 years of overall experience in advanced software engineering and AI systems, including leading AI, GenAI, or autonomous agent initiatives at enterprise scale . Proven track record in architecting and scaling agentic AI platforms across multiple domains, teams, and geographies. Deep expertise in multi-agent systems , autonomous decision-making, planning and reasoning architectures, human-agent collaboration, and enterprise workflow automation. Advanced hands-on and conceptual mastery of LLMs , prompt/program synthesis strategies, reasoning frameworks, evaluation methodologies, and continuous learning loops. Strong experience with agent frameworks and platforms (LangChain, LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI, etc.) with the ability to design custom enterprise-grade agent foundations beyond framework defaults. Expert-level understanding of agent orchestration , including hierarchical/task-based planning, tool invocation strategies, exception handling, resilience patterns, and agent collaboration protocols without over-dependence on LangChain/LangGraph-style abstractions. Deep knowledge of memory, state, and context management , including short-term/long-term memory, vector databases, knowledge graphs, session isolation, and lifecycle governance. Advanced experience with RAG systems , search relevance optimization, grounding strategies, hallucination mitigation, and enterprise knowledge integration. Demonstrated algorithmic and model stewardship , including evaluation frameworks, risk modelling, bias analysis, and continuous optimization. Extensive experience deploying and operating AI platforms on Google Cloud Platform (GCP) using scalable, secure, and cost-efficient cloud-native architectures. Experience working with Postgre database. Strong leadership in MLOps and AI Platform Engineering , including CI/CD, model and prompt lifecycle management, testing at scale, and controlled enterprise releases. Expertise in AI observability and governance , including telemetry, tracing, quality evaluation frameworks, explainability dashboards, and cost governance. Strong command of AI security, privacy, and regulatory compliance , aligning with enterprise policies, industry regulations, and Responsible AI standards. Preferred: Deep exposure to General Insurance (Health, Motor, Travel) or other regulated industries, with experience driving AI-led transformation of core business processes. Leadership & Behavioural Competencies: Demonstrates strategic thinking, executive presence, and systems-level problem solving in highly complex environments. Communicates with clarity and influence at senior leadership and C-suite levels, bridging business strategy and deep technology. Inspires and develops senior technical leaders, fostering innovation, accountability, and engineering excellence at scale. Exhibits strong professional integrity, decisiveness, and resilience in high-stakes, mission-critical AI initiatives.

description:

We expect to complete the separation by the end of the first quarter of 2027. As a standalone company, the Mobility business will be more focused and agile, creating exciting opportunities for employees to grow, innovate, and help shape the future of mobility. The separation reflects strong confidence in the Mobility team and positions the new company as an employer of choice in the automotive and commercial vehicle industry. The compensation and benefits that will initially be offered for this position are based on Eaton's plans, programs and practices. If you are offered and accept this position and are actively employed by the Mobility Group when the spinoff closes, the new company will provide further details to employees concerning compensation and benefits at that time. title: Admission Counsellor
description:
Position: School Admission Counsellor
 Department: Admissions / Administration
 Experience: 1-3 Years
 Employment Type: Full-Time
 Location: NIBM Road, Kondhwa, Pune
 Reporting To: Admission Head & Principal 
 Position Overview 
 We are looking for a professional, confident, and parent-friendly Admission Officer who will be responsible for managing the end-to-end admission enquiry process along with front office operations . The candidate will serve as the first point of contact for prospective parents, students, visitors, and other stakeholders , creating a warm and professional impression of the school. The role will involve handling admission enquiries, counselling parents, conducting follow-ups, coordinating school visits, maintaining admission records, and supporting the smooth functioning of the front office. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 1. Admissions & Parent Counselling Handle admission enquiries received through walk-ins, telephone calls, emails, WhatsApp and online platforms . Understand parents' requirements and provide accurate information about the school's curriculum, academic programmes, facilities, fee structure, activities, and admission process . Counsel prospective parents and students and address their queries professionally. Conduct and coordinate school/campus tours for prospective parents. Explain the complete admission process, eligibility criteria, documentation requirements and timelines. Follow up with prospective parents regularly and support enquiry-to-admission conversion . Coordinate appointments and interactions with the Principal, Coordinators, or relevant academic team members. Assist parents with admission forms, document submission, assessments and other admission formalities. Ensure a smooth and positive parent experience throughout the admission journey. 
 2. Lead Management & Follow-up Maintain an updated database of all admission enquiries and leads. Record and track enquiries, follow-ups, visits, applications and admissions . Ensure timely follow-up with prospective parents and maintain proper communication records. Monitor pending enquiries and ensure that no prospective lead is missed. Prepare daily/weekly admission reports and share updates with the reporting manager. Work towards achieving assigned admission/enquiry conversion targets. 
 3. Front Office Operations Act as the first point of contact for parents, students, visitors and guests. Welcome and assist visitors in a warm, courteous and professional manner. Handle incoming and outgoing calls and direct them to the appropriate department/person. Handle general parent/visitor queries and ensure appropriate resolution or escalation. Maintain front office records, registers and other administrative documents. Coordinate with Administration, Academics, Transport, Accounts and other departments as required. 
 4. School Events & Admission Activities Support and coordinate Open Houses, Parent Orientation, Admission Events and School Tours . Assist in admission campaigns and other school promotional activities. Support the school during peak admission periods, events and parent interaction days. Represent the school professionally while interacting with prospective families. 
 5. Documentation & MIS Ensure accurate maintenance of admission forms and supporting documents. Update admission data in the school's ERP/CRM/Admission Management System . Maintain confidentiality and accuracy of student and parent information. Prepare admission-related MIS and reports as required by management. Maintain proper records of admission status, pending documents and follow-ups. 
 Candidate Profile 
 Education: Graduate in any discipline. Additional qualification in Management, Education, Administration or Customer Relationship Management will be an advantage. 
 Experience: 1-3 years of experience in School Admissions, Front Office, Counselling, Customer Service, Education Sales or a similar role. Prior experience in a school/educational institution will be preferred. 
 Required Skills Excellent verbal and written communication skills , particularly in English. Strong interpersonal and parent-handling skills. Good counselling and convincing abilities. Pleasant, confident and professional personality. Strong follow-up and relationship-management skills. Good organizational and multitasking abilities. Proficiency in MS Office, Excel, Google Workspace and/or CRM/ERP systems . Ability to work under pressure, particularly during the admission season. Strong attention to detail and documentation skills. Presentable and professional in appearance and conduct. 
 Key Competencies 
 Parent Relationship Management | Admission Counselling | Lead Conversion | Follow-up | Front Office Management | Communication | Customer Service | MIS & Reporting | Coordination | Multitasking 
 Performance Indicators / KRAs Number of admission enquiries handled. Enquiry-to-visit conversion. Visit-to-admission conversion. Timely follow-up of leads. Accuracy of admission records and documentation. Parent satisfaction and service quality. Efficient management of front office operations. Timely submission of admission reports and MIS. 
 Preferred Candidate 
 The ideal candidate should be warm, articulate, target-oriented, organized and confident in interacting with parents . The person should be capable of balancing admission responsibilities with day-to-day front office duties while maintaining a professional image of the school.

title: Senior Business Process Executive - Accounts Payable
description:
Position: Senior BPE Accounts Payable 
 Location: Work from Office Pune, India 
 Experience: 2–6 years 
 Shift: US Business Hours / Night Shift, as per client requirements 8PM to 5AM 
 Employment Type: Full-Time 
 Software: Oracle EBS 12.1 
 About the Role IBN Technologies is looking for an experienced Senior BPE to support an international AP outsourcing engagement for USA Client. The role will be responsible for end-to-end invoice processing, PO and Non-PO invoice management, exception resolution, vendor query handling, payment support, reconciliations, reporting, and adherence to AP controls and SLAs.The successful candidate should have strong hands-on experience in Accounts Payable operations, preferably in a global/multi-entity environment, with exposure to Oracle EBS 12.1, invoice processing, vendor master processes, approval workflows, and AP exception management. 
 Key Responsibilities1. Invoice Processing Process PO and Non-PO invoices accurately and within agreed SLAs. Perform invoice validation against POs, receipts, contracts, tax information, and supporting documentation. Validate invoice coding, including GL account, cost center, business unit, tax codes, and other accounting dimensions. Identify duplicate invoices and potential duplicate payments. Process credit memos, recurring invoices, utility invoices, freight invoices, and employee-related invoices where applicable. Ensure invoices are accurately entered and posted into Oracle EBS. 
 2. Non-PO & Exception Management Review and resolve Non-PO invoice exceptions. Investigate issues such as: Missing PO Missing receipt Price variance Quantity variance Tax discrepancy Incorrect vendor Incorrect GL coding Missing approvals Coordinate with Procurement, Receiving, Finance, business users, and vendors to resolve exceptions. Monitor exception aging and ensure timely resolution. Identify recurring exception trends and recommend process improvements. 
 3. Vendor Management & Help Desk Respond to vendor inquiries related to invoice status, payments, documentation, and discrepancies. Coordinate supplier onboarding and vendor-master activities where included in scope. Support vendor master creation and maintenance in accordance with approved controls. Follow established procedures for supplier bank-account changes. Ensure maker-checker and approval controls are followed for sensitive vendor changes. Escalate suspicious or non-compliant vendor requests appropriately. 
 4. Payment Support Support payment proposal preparation and payment-related AP activities. Validate invoices included in payment runs. Coordinate with appropriate stakeholders for payment exceptions and approvals. Support payment reconciliation and investigation of payment discrepancies. Follow strict controls for supplier banking information and payment-related activities. 
 5. Reconciliation & Month-End Support Support AP subledger and related reconciliations. Assist with cash/account reconciliation activities where applicable. Support month-end and year-end close activities. Ensure open invoices, exceptions, advances, credits, and aging items are appropriately reviewed. Prepare required month-end reports and supporting schedules. 
 6. 1099 Support Support the 1099 process, where included in the final scope. Validate vendor tax information and applicable 1099 classifications. Support 1099 preparation, reconciliation, filing, and recipient distribution as required. Investigate and resolve 1099 discrepancies and exceptions. Maintain appropriate documentation for audit and compliance purposes. 
 7. Oracle EBS & Technology Work extensively with Oracle EBS 12.1 for invoice processing and AP activities. Follow established Oracle workflows and approval processes. Work with OCR/Intelligent Document Processing tools where applicable. Use available automation/RPA tools to improve processing efficiency. Support AI-assisted GL coding or invoice validation processes with appropriate human review and approval. Report system/interface issues to the appropriate technical team. 
 8. Reporting & SLA Management Monitor daily AP productivity, quality, turnaround time, exception aging, and backlog. Prepare daily/weekly/monthly operational reports. Track KPIs and SLAs including: Invoice processing turnaround time Invoice accuracy Exception rate Duplicate invoice/payment rate Backlog Vendor inquiry response time Productivity Identify SLA risks and escalate them proactively. 
 9. Process Improvement Identify opportunities to reduce manual intervention and improve AP efficiency. Participate in automation and process-improvement initiatives. Analyze recurring exceptions and recommend root-cause solutions. Support standardization across multiple entities/countries. Participate in transition, knowledge-transfer, UAT, and process stabilization activities. 
 Required Skills & Experience 3–6 years of hands-on Accounts Payable experience. Strong experience in: PO and Non-PO invoice processing Invoice validation 2-way/3-way matching Exception management Vendor reconciliation Payment processing/support AP aging and reconciliation Month-end close Working experience with Oracle EBS, preferably Oracle EBS 12.1. Good understanding of AP controls and maker-checker processes. Experience handling vendor queries and business-user escalations. Good understanding of GL coding, cost centers, tax codes, and invoice accounting. Exposure to multi-entity or international AP operations. Good knowledge of Excel, including Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP and basic data analysis. Strong written and verbal communication skills. Ability to work independently and meet strict SLAs. 
 Preferred Skills experience with Oracle EBS 12.1 Experience supporting US-based AP operations. Experience with Oracle Purchasing, iProcurement, Receiving, General Ledger, or Cash Management. Experience with vendor master management and supplier onboarding. Exposure to US tax concepts relevant to AP. Experience working in a BPO/shared-services environment. Experience supporting process transitions and migrations. 
 Behavioral Competencies Strong attention to detail and accuracy. Ownership and accountability for assigned transactions. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Proactive approach to identifying exceptions and process gaps. Ability to communicate effectively with vendors, business users, and client stakeholders. Ability to work under volume and SLA pressure. Strong control and compliance mindset. Willingness to learn new technology and automation tools.

title: Software Engineering Manager, Agentic Transformation
description:
Agents are changing how all software will be built. Agentic systems can perform substantial engineering work. It is still unproven whether they can be a reliable production capability at graphics systems quality standards. Meanwhile, teams continue shipping new features, sustaining platforms, and meeting product commitments. Graphics drivers are a difficult proving ground. They involve large codebases, complex hardware-OS interactions, strict performance demands, broad application compatibility, and formal safety obligations in automotive. NVIDIA seeks an engineering manager in India to develop a new framework for agentic software development. You will test this model against one of our most fast-paced production software stacks. You will lead a graphics systems team through this transition and continue delivering the necessary product roadmap. Afterwards, you will transform effective practices into a reusable engineering product for other teams. You will grow the people, technology, and operating model together, creating an ambitious, highly engaged team that uses agents to surpass typical capacity. Success goes beyond one team s transformation; it establishes a production-proven system for software development in the agentic era at NVIDIA. What you ll be doing: Develop and launch an end-to-end production model for agentic software development. Apply it to graphics systems, where agents perform engineering tasks from requirements and diagnosis to implementation, validation, review, and release. Define the technical strategy and transformation roadmap, turning fast paced agentic capabilities into dependable production execution and steadily growing the work agents complete end to end. Keep the team delivering its must-do graphics and display roadmap. This includes new features, platform enablement, performance, stability, and release commitments. At the same time, fundamentally evolve how that work gets done. Build an ambitious, highly engaged team that produces outstanding results, nurturing engineers and technical leaders alongside the technology and operating model. Transform the established agentic engineering system into a reusable product for other teams. Package its orchestration, skills, tools, evaluations, validators, and operating methods. Collaborate across NVIDIA to encourage adoption with measurable production outcomes. What we need to see: Demonstrated experience developing and delivering production software via autonomous engineering systems that include planning, tool application, retrieval, memory, evaluation, and validation, with agents handling a significant portion of actual engineering tasks. Demonstrated ability to turn a fast paced and ambiguous technical opportunity into a clear strategy, roadmap, and measurable production system while keeping an existing product roadmap on track. 10+ overall years of software engineering experience, including 3+ years of engineering management or technical leadership, with a degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or equivalent experience. Strong technical foundations in complex production software, including systems architecture, debugging, validation, CI/CD, and release engineering. High-agency, results-focused leadership: you build an environment where people grow, enjoy doing their best work, and use technology to deliver results far beyond the team s traditional capacity. Ways to stand out from the crowd: Acknowledged advancements in the field of agentic systems, shown through peer-reviewed publications, widely embraced open-source projects, public benchmarks, or other externally validated outcomes. Experience with graphics or display driver development and technologies such as Vulkan, OpenGL ES, EGL, SurfaceFlinger, HWC, Gralloc, UMD/KMD drivers, X11, or Wayland. Familiarity with NVIDIA DRIVE OS and experience developing safety-critical automotive software using standards such as ISO 26262 and ASIL. Meaningful contributions to the Linux kernel, graphics software ecosystem, developer tools, or other broadly adopted systems software. NVIDIA is widely considered one of the technology world s most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward-thinking and hardworking people in the world working with us. If you are a creative and autonomous engineering leader who wants to invent how the most demanding production software will be built in the agentic era and prove it by helping real driver teams ship, we would love to hear from you.

title: Outbound Logistics
description:
Position: Ex / Sr. Ex Outbound - Logistics Department: Logistics Experience: Minimum 4 - 6yrs Qualification:  Graduate in any discipline; a diploma/degree in Supply Chain, Logistics, or Operations Management preferred. 
 JOB PURPOSE: The Ex / Sr. Ex Outbound - Logistics is responsible for end-to-end management of the plant's dispatch function, including inbound receipt of material from Production and the RM Warehouse, put-away and rack management, sales order fulfillment, finished goods and scrap inventory management, safe and compliant loading of outbound vehicles across multiple loading bays, invoicing and statutory documentation, and tracking of shipments through to final delivery. The role ensures accurate, timely, and compliant dispatch operations while maintaining a safe working environment. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES 1. Receiving & Put-Away Receive finished goods inventory from the Production department, verifying quantity, quality, and documentation against production output records. Receive raw material (RM) consignments from the RM Warehouse / inbound vehicles, cross-checking against purchase orders, delivery challans, and weighment slips. Inspect incoming material for damage, shortages, or discrepancies and report deviations to the Logistics Manager immediately. Plan and execute put-away of received material into designated racks/bins as per storage layout, SKU classification, and FIFO/FEFO norms. Maintain rack location mapping and update the Warehouse Management System (WMS)/ERP with accurate bin locations for easy traceability. 2. Sales Order Fulfillment & Picking Receive and review sales orders released by the Sales team and plan order fulfillment based on stock availability, priority, and dispatch schedule. Coordinate picking of material from racks as per pick-lists, ensuring correct SKU, batch/lot, and quantity is selected. Verify picked material against the sales order before staging for dispatch to minimize errors and returns. Coordinate with the Sales team on order status, stock shortages, part-shipments, and expected fulfillment timelines. 3. Finished Goods Inventory Management Maintain real-time and accurate inventory records for all finished goods across racks and storage locations. Conduct periodic cycle counts and physical stock verification; reconcile discrepancies with system records. Monitor stock ageing, minimum/maximum levels, and slow-moving inventory, and flag issues to the Logistics Manager. Ensure proper labelling, batch/lot identification, and segregation of finished goods by category/grade. 4. General Scrap Management Manage receipt, segregation, and safe storage of general scrap generated from plant operations in designated scrap yards/bays. Maintain lot-wise records of scrap (category, weight/quantity, grade) and update inventory in the system. Share timely and accurate information on available scrap lots with the Sales team to support sale/auction planning. Coordinate dispatch and loading of sold scrap lots, ensuring correct lot identification, weighment, and documentation. Ensure scrap storage areas are maintained in an orderly, hazard-free, and environmentally compliant manner. 5. Transfer to Dispatch Area & Vehicle Planning Coordinate timely transfer of picked/staged material from racks/storage to the dispatch marshalling area. Plan vehicle scheduling in coordination with transporters to avoid bay congestion and detention charges. Allocate vehicles to appropriate loading bays based on order type, vehicle size, and dispatch priority. Manage and supervise operations across multiple loading bays simultaneously, ensuring smooth turnaround of vehicles. 6. Loading & Vehicle Dispatch Supervise safe and systematic loading of material/scrap onto vehicles as per load plan and vehicle capacity. Ensure correct material, quantity, and documentation accompany each vehicle prior to gate release. Ensure proper securing/lashing of load and compliance with vehicle safety norms before dispatch. Record weighment (gross/tare/net) at the weighbridge and ensure entries match invoice/challan quantities. 7. Invoicing, Compliance & Documentation Generate sales invoices, delivery challans, e-way bills, and other statutory documents accurately and in a timely manner. Ensure all dispatches comply with applicable regulatory requirements for e-waste handling, transportation, and hazardous/general scrap movement (e.g., E-Waste (Management) Rules, Pollution Control Board authorizations, transport permits). Maintain proper filing and record-keeping of dispatch documents, weighment slips, gate passes, and vehicle records for audit and compliance purposes. Coordinate with the Accounts/Commercial team for invoice accuracy, payment terms, and documentation queries. 8. Tracking & Delivery Track dispatched vehicles/consignments until confirmed delivery at the customer/buyer location. Proactively follow up with transporters on delays, breakdowns, or route issues and keep stakeholders informed. Obtain and file proof of delivery (POD) and resolve any delivery-related discrepancies or claims. 9. Safety in Operations Ensure strict adherence to safety protocols during receiving, put-away, picking, loading, and material handling activities. Ensure proper use of PPE by all personnel and contract labour engaged in dispatch and loading operations. Conduct/participate in safety checks of material handling equipment (forklifts, hand pallet trucks, cranes, etc.) prior to use. Report unsafe conditions, near-misses, and incidents promptly; support root-cause analysis and corrective actions. Promote good housekeeping (5S) across racking areas, dispatch bays, and scrap storage yards. 10. Multi-Bay & Team Coordination Coordinate manpower and equipment deployment across multiple loading bays to ensure optimal utilization and no dispatch delays. Liaise with Production, RM Warehouse, Sales, Accounts, Security, and Transport teams for seamless dispatch operations. Provide regular dispatch status reports, stock reports, and scrap lot updates to the Logistics Manager – Plant. KEY SKILLS & COMPETENCIES Strong knowledge of warehouse operations, inventory management, and dispatch processes. Working knowledge of WMS/ERP systems (e.g., SAP) for stock, order, and invoicing transactions. Strong understanding and statutory dispatch documentation (invoice, e-way bill, challan). Good coordination and communication skills to manage multiple stakeholders and loading bays simultaneously. Strong attention to detail and accuracy in stock reconciliation and documentation. Commitment to workplace safety and adherence to SOPs. Ability to work under pressure and manage multiple dispatch priorities in a fast-paced plant environment. QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE Graduate in any discipline; a diploma/degree in Supply Chain, Logistics, or Operations Management preferred. Min 4 years of experience of warehousing and dispatch operations in manufacturing environment. Proficient in MS Excel and ERP/WMS systems. KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS (KPIs) On-time dispatch and order fulfillment rate. Inventory accuracy (finished goods and scrap) vs. system records. Vehicle turnaround time across loading bays. Compliance adherence – zero documentation errors/statutory non-compliance. Safety incidents/near-misses in dispatch area – target zero. Timeliness of scrap lot information shared with Sales team and effective management of scrap inventory. Delivery Tracking

Key Skills: Inventory Management,Stock Management,Inventory Planning,Outbound Logistics Management,Material Planning,Sales Order Fulfillment,FEFO,Outbound logistics

 About the Role 
We are looking for a talented and creative Video Editor to join our marketing team and transform raw footage, screen recordings, customer conversations, interviews, and event content into engaging videos that capture attention and tell a strong story.
You will work on product demos, customer testimonials, social media videos, LinkedIn content, event recaps, advertisements, webinars, and internal videos .
This is a high-volume, fast-paced role for someone who has strong editorial judgment, understands social media pacing, and can consistently deliver high-quality content within tight timelines.
 Key Responsibilities 
 Edit long-form and short-form videos including product walkthroughs, customer testimonials, interviews, webinars, event recaps, and social media content. Convert long recordings and interviews into engaging, scroll-stopping short-form videos . Create videos optimized for LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, and other digital channels . Work closely with the marketing team to transform rough concepts and raw footage into polished final videos. Maintain consistent visual language across videos, including captions, motion graphics, transitions, color, audio, and pacing. Identify the strongest moments from lengthy or unstructured footage and build compelling stories around them. Add professional captions, subtitles, text overlays, lower-thirds, and basic motion graphics . Perform basic color correction, audio cleanup, noise reduction, and volume balancing . Manage multiple video projects and maintain a consistent weekly content output. Organize raw footage, project files, assets, exports, and different video versions efficiently. Occasionally support basic on-site video shooting and content capture when required. Required Skills 
 Expert-level knowledge of Adobe Premiere Pro - Mandatory Working knowledge of Adobe After Effects for motion graphics, lower-thirds, kinetic text, and animations. Strong understanding of short-form/social media video editing and pacing . Ability to create a strong hook within the first few seconds of a video. Excellent storytelling and editorial judgment. Ability to identify the most valuable moments from long and unstructured footage independently. Strong skills in captioning and subtitle styling . Basic knowledge of color correction and audio editing/cleanup . Ability to create simple motion graphics, animated text, transitions, and visual effects from scratch. Strong attention to detail and visual consistency. Ability to work quickly and manage high-volume video production . Strong file organization and project/version management skills. What We are Looking For
We are not looking for someone who only applies templates or preset effects .
We want an editor who can watch raw footage, understand the story, identify what matters, and turn it into content people actually want to watch.
The ideal candidate should have strong creative judgment, storytelling ability, social-media awareness, attention to detail, and speed .
Good to Have
 Basic knowledge of camera, lighting, and video shooting . Experience creating content for B2B SaaS, healthcare, technology, or corporate brands . Understanding of US healthcare or medical technology is an advantage but not mandatory . Why Join Us? 
 Opportunity to work on content for a growing US healthcare technology/SaaS business . Exposure to product marketing, customer stories, social media, and brand content. High-ownership role with significant creative freedom. Fast-paced environment with opportunities to experiment and build your editing portfolio. Opportunity to work across multiple formats and content channels.

title: Assistant Manager HSE
description:
Position:- Asst. Manager HSE Exp - 4-7 years Job Purpose To drive the continual development and maturity of Sodexo Safety Culture and Safe Behaviors by demonstrating safety leadership behaviors and embedding the Group Zero Harm Mindset initiatives. Deploy the implementation of the APMEA Food and Health and Safety Processes across all sites, Adaption of APMEA processes, where required, into Country / Local Processes to check legal compliance within country /area of responsibility. The overall mission is to deliver safe and compliant work solutions for operations teams providing services. This will be achieved by operationally implementing APMEA HSE systems and procedures and where required, identify any policy and or procedure gaps or omissions or variations required. Also assist in the development of HSE solutions specifically for our clients. Roles and Responsibilities 
 Make sure deployment of Zero Harm mindset within frontline employees. Make sure Safety improvement plan action implemented at site/ account. Confirm deployment of Sodexo Safety Net and Client Safety initiative at site / account. Food Safety Responsible of overall upkeep, food hygiene and safety standards of the location. Monitor activities through out food chain for upkeep of Food safety standards. Risk Assessment - Identify the potential risk related to working environment, machinery or equipment and suggest the preventive measure to site manager. Prepare Risk Assessment & Risk Register. Update risk assessment post incident or new scope addition. Train all frontline staff in hazard identification and reporting. Communicate risk assessment to staff. Legal Register - Prepare and update Legal Register. Make sure all legal compliance in place and escalate in case of Non compliances. Safety Walk and Safety Observation - Conduct safety walks and Safety Observation. Report in Salus system and track for closure Near Miss - Create awareness on Nearmiss reporting and report Nearmiss in Salus Incident Management - Inform regional HSE & region Head. Investigate the incident and Prepare RCA along with Site Manager and team. Make sure all root causes corrective actions implemented at site. Share Incident learning with site teams, HSE Practices - Make sure adherence to Time temperature, FIFO, Sorting Process, Thawing, salt & Turmeric processes, CCPs, Deep Cleaning, Pest Control, PPM of Equipment, Electrical Safety, Global engineering practices, HSMS processes. Documentation - Monitoring that all checklists and records are maintained. Cleaning Checklist, Pest Control Records, 11/ A-L files, Temperature records, COA, E-guarantee form, Invoices etc. Escalate in case of repeated deviations. HSE Trainings -Prepare Training Matrix. Inform site manager in advance of planned training (TBT, Quick Share, Campaign, regular training etc.). Conduct HSE induction for new joiners. Make sure compliance to Training Matrix update Site wise Training Tracker. Training compliance to be tracked as per training calendar in training tracker. Upload training details to Access system. Safety Campaigns -Plan and arrange the various safety motivation program such as safety day celebration, safety contest to motivate and spread awareness among the staff. Calibrations - Verify that calibration of equipment e.g., thermometer probe, GLD, weighing balance, pressure gauge is being carried out on defined frequency. Conduct Self inspection and Safety declaration monthly and track and close all reported gaps / observations. HSE Audit Findings - Follow, track and Coordinate with site manager, region head and client for closures. Escalate in case of overdue. Food Sample Retention - Periodically verify the sample and freezer temperature. Report deviation to site manager and escalate in case sample are not retained. Mobilization Framework – Make sure HSE mobilization framework includes MOB 03, BCP, ERP, Communication Board, PPE matrix, HSE Files and Folders, HSE induction training, HSE Accountability, Risk Assessment, Hazard Analysis, SOP implementation. Follow up for due diligence points with client or vendor or region head. Subcontractor Management- Co-ordinate with Site Leads and SCM and make sure subcontractor Management processes are implemented across all sites. Monitor vendor partner’s activities for the compliance on food & Health and Safety practices. PPE Compliance - verify that all staff are using the required PPE while performing the task. Provide list and quantity of required PPE. Prepare PPE matrix. Raise negligence issues with region head. Report negligence issues in Access HR. Lab Testing - Coordinate with site manager and verify that periodic external food and water testing is being done. Review test report for suitability and make sure samples are send as per sampling plan SNAG list - Provide inputs related to snag points. Follow-up with site manager & client for closure. Participate in joint discussion with client for snag. Review health condition of equipment and suggest for rectification and addition of safety feature, if required connect with regional purchase or client. Miscellaneous – Food Inspector Visit - Inform Regional HSE and Regional Head. To provide compliance documents. Co-ordinate with food testing lab for testing (reference sample). Obtain COA, invoice of sample. Review the existing SOP and recommended corrections Support for BCP Review and Audit, MMR and QBR Data support, Emergency Response and Mock Drill at site / account. Job Requirements Qualifications 
 Graduate / Postgraduate – BSC/ MSC/ B.E/ B. Tech - Food Certified Lead auditor ISO22000/ HACCP / ISO 9001 / ISO45001 – (Optional) Advance Diploma in Food Safety (Optional) Certified Food safety HACCP Level 3 & Food Safety Level 4 (Optional) Experience 
 Minimum 2-5 years' experience in Food Safety and Health and Safety Systems Management Experience working with industrial food safety and occupational work safety. Functional Competencies 
 Business Know-How – Understanding of our business Awareness about the Socio-Economic, Legal, Political forces that impact our nature of business Client Obsessed - Understanding their needs, focus points, adding & delivering value Industry Clue-In; Aware of the Best Practices / Business Insights Financial Acumen - Understanding of Financial Parameters and impact on Business Behavioral Competencies 
 Optimizes Work Process Drives Results Courage Good Decision Quality Effective Communication Drive Accountability Collaborates Being Resilient Manages Ambiguity
